verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party SSO plugin documents support for OpenID Connect, OAuth2 providers and SAML 2.0, and the homepage markets it as enterprise-ready with SSO and SAML 2.0. A community comment independently confirms SAML capability, though it notes some of these features are enterprise-only. missing for 10: documented setup or compatibility with the named IdPs (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace), detail on workforce SSO flows such as domain routing and IdP configuration, hands-on corroboration of SAML/OIDC connections, clarity on which SSO features are gated to an enterprise tier.
